turns.text: what happens when hiu requests records?

must_contain: the HIU requests consent to view the patient's data through the gateway
the HIE-CM acknowledges the request and returns a consent request id to the HIU
the HIE-CM notifies the patient that a consent request has been made
the patient can view the request details and choose to grant or deny consent
notes: variant a of faq-verbatim-sandbox-m3-07, the same question as a developer in a hurry would type it
